mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 3.6% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.6% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weak consumer demand and business investment, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL y/y growth > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL y/y growth exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior month indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines below 108 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 108 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline by at least 0.5% from their 3-month averages, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 y/y growth > 2.0%), strong economic momentum supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 y/y growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
